rawContent: Hey - check it out! My colleagues put out a Your Right to Protest video! Juan and Franz definitely know your rights when it comes to police interaction, so pay attention. Thanks, guys. I need this as I hit the streets again tonight. #BlackLivesMatter #PortlandProtests

“Black people have been 28% of those killed by police since 2013 despite being only 13% of the population.” But, sure, that’s not why we’ve been in the streets 80 days. @tedwheeler @ChiefCLovell #BlackLivesMatter

Say her name. Say all the names. Stay in the streets - this fight isn’t over. #BreonnaTaylor #JacobBlake #GeorgeFloyd #AhmaudArbery #MichaelBrown #EricGarner #TamirRice #KendraJames #KeetonOtis #AtatianaJefferson #PhilandoCastille #AltonSterling #StephonClark #BlackLivesMatter
Josie is a client of the @OJRCenter. We stand with Josie and all members of Oregon’s BIPOC community. #BlackLivesMatter #StandWithJosie
Portland shows up! Proud to be in that crowd, marching with the @pdxnaacp in support of the Black Lives Matter movement. #Portland #KeepGoing #BlackLivesMatter #MarchOnWashington2020
